title: 日本ダービーの後に・昇り炎舞

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's down to the final stretch! The racers pick up the pace in a bid to win the title of Derby champion!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I won't let you beat me! The Derby is mine!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No way! I won't give up! I'm winning this for Maruzen!

text_block_list.name: Ardan & Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Aaaaahhh! Raaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (…I'm going to lose. I'm being overpowered!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I don't care if my legs shatter! I will burn out my very lifeforce! And that light will serve as proof that I was alive!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No, no, no, no, nooo! The Derby's mine! It's miiiiine!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: (…No! Losing is not an option. I will not… abiiide… defeeeat!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I… AM…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: THE STRONGEEEST! THEEERE! IIIIIS! RAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She's pulled ahead of the pack and powers straight to the finish line! The title of Derby champion this year goes to—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Amazing… Wow, my heart's still racing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Chiyo. Thank you, everybody. What an incredible Derby!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff… Sniffle…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I lost, Maruzen… I lost our Derby…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Sob… Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In that moment… I…

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: You were so intense, Yaeno! I had goosebumps!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, what a great race! It felt like you were all duking it out with your very souls!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …R-really?!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: It was definitely one for the record books!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …Much obliged!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O… Ardan…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah… Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I would like to express my gratitude to the both of you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: But what for?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It was your incredible passion that drew today's performance out of me.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I didn't want to be outdone… I wanted to light my soul ablaze and burn just as brightly as you two.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Are you saying that we were visibly glowing?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: In my eyes, you certainly were.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Your very souls were aglow, lit by your determination to claim victory no matter the cost.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I was entranced by the way you ran.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: My! Is that so…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I may not have claimed the achievement I so ardently wanted, but it appears I still managed to leave proof of my existence…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I certainly think so. Your brilliant image is deeply burned onto my heart.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I sure hope Maruzen feels the same way…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: From the way she's smiling, I'm sure she does.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: …Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O. Ardan. Thank you both for showing me such fierce determination.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you too, Yaeno.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But I'm going to come out on top next time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I shall seize victory no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Do not think I shall yield so easily!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Laughing mirthfully, the three shake hands. But in stark contrast…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki's expression is meek when she returns to the waiting room. There's no trace of her smile from the turf.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I have to reflect on my shameful behavior. I made a grave mistake which cannot be ignored.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I let my emotions get the better of me near the end of the race, and ran to the whims of my own competitive drive.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The powerful cries Chiyono O and Ardan let out from deep within their souls overwhelmed me and stole away my reason…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It was as if I was hearing my own impending defeat.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But in that same instant, the fierce blaze within me cried out. They refused to take defeat lying down and urged me to fight back!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My blood started boiling, and I became furious. I tried to stop my rampaging legs, but to no avail.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …I was on the verge of losing control.
choice_data_list: But you were able to put up a great fight because of that.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I agree. And I am satisfied with today's results.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I had an incredible race with Chiyono O and Ardan, and I was able to run at my very best.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Indeed, it was the very best that I can do currently. But…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Had I not let loose my emotions, I would have been left behind with no hope of fighting for the lead.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: My lack of strength and inexperience are to blame, and that must not be overlooked.
choice_data_list: Well, sometimes it's a matter of will.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Close matches between racers of equal prowess are oftentimes won by whoever has greater willpower.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's race was one such instance. As such, I tell her there's no need to feel discouraged.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But… I cannot guarantee that I won't lose control if I find myself in the same circumstances again.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Justifying such a volatile running style would be irresponsible…
choice_data_list: We'll just have to hone your ability to wield both blaze fierce and water still.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: By improving her running ability and strategy, she should be able to win without letting her emotions run rampant.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Very well. I agree that's our best approach.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Phew… I'm relieved we're in accord.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on you to help me deliver a stable performance at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's highly likely that Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan will be at the Kikuka Sho, given that it's the final race in the Classic Triple Crown.
choice_data_list: I think you'll be in for another tough battle.
I think you'll be in for another tough battle.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: As do I. But I'm also looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: For it will be my chance to have an even greater battle against Chiyono O and Ardan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's clear from her smile that Yaeno Muteki has a burning desire to reach even greater heights with her rivals at the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, a few days later…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We receive unexpected news that Sakura Chiyono O and Mejiro Ardan will both be taking time off from racing due to injuries.
